# CM v3 native replay test code

This deterministic archive contains the 120 code, schema, and resolver dependencies
of CultureMech source commit `6f1b1d18a5528532fa239400bd73c1a040fb78a0`, plus its
three source license files. It contains no normalized recipe corpus. The original
member hashes and archive lineage are recorded in `provenance.json`. The packaged
MIM label index is retained as an authenticated resolver dependency.

Tests create one synthetic recipe in an owned tree and run the genuine build and
verifier. The resulting source has two positive occurrences, one context-only
removal, and one identity-held mention. Authentic historical MIM preparation and
finalization then retain two supported and two withheld decisions. These are
fixture assertions, not scientific or publication approvals.

Original licenses are preserved inside the archive as `LICENSE`, `LICENSE-CODE`,
and `LICENSE-DATA`. No test reads or executes the real campaign source package.
